ConcreteCoupling: Execution.Evaluate calls ReduceAsync before each evaluated expression (Execution.cs384). ProcessContext.ChargeAsync charges1 or explicitbump and yields at cooperative slice2000.
Initial actor body is dispatched by TaskFactory on ConcurrentExclusiveSchedulerPair. Current Dispatch signature receives only body, not owner; no per-owner priority can be selected.
Named/anonymous deep-stack protections yield separately at Execution.cs108/257. These are stack unwinding scheduling points, not charged slice expiry, and must retain the approved recursion behavior.

Runtime BIF and ownership helpers use ConfigureAwait(false), including links/sends, allocator query completion, module onload/retirement and NIF initialization wrappers. Adding a TaskScheduler alone is insufficient to prove all guest re-entry stays on the intended owner queue. Inner helper escape does not by itself prove an externally observable scheduling bug; caller recapture has to be traced.
FeasibleDesignChoice: Implement process-owned TaskScheduler proxies over a shared priority runnable arbiter AND explicit owner-aware cooperative resume admission. Initial actor Dispatch accepts owner. Proxy QueueTask classifies by current owner priority and routes captured await continuations. The runtime-owned YieldToScheduler(context) path replaces reduction Task.Yield, while stack-unwind yield preserves non-recursive continuation and also re-enters owner admission. Host-only I/O/retirement work may remain on default scheduler; any call back into guest code must re-admit context.
AdmissionHazardsToResolveBeforeCodeClaim: Do not acquire a permit then await for a continuation that needs the same permit (capacity1 deadlock). Execute task via correct owner proxy so TaskScheduler.Current remains stable.
An owner awaiting a real receive/IO must not hold a runnable slot. Requeue on completion; capacity counts synchronous runnable turns rather than entire async lifetime.
active actor lifetime count for CompleteWhenIdle differs from queued/running continuation count; retirement must accept continuation cleanup for admitted actors.
Queued reprioritization and process termination require single queue ownership; no dropped finally, duplicate turns or stale queued owner resurrection.
Do not change CooperativeSlice2000 or RESCHEDULE_LOW8 merely to fit throughput tests. Physical ERTS scheduling/reduction-cost/affinity remains unclaimed.
NextImplementationBoundary: Local normal/high/max/low real cooperative runqueue+process_flag2 priority return-old and process_info2; shared spawn default and duplicate options initialized before dispatch. Include sender/receiver option propagation using existing connected generation controls before claiming remote overload parity.
